title: Writing Practice — Tours in local parks — Assess the trade-offs
description: Academic Task 1 data report and Task 2 essay. Assess the trade-offs. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The table shows people taking part in four types of guided park tour in two comparable surveys.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Some parks provide self-guided tours through audio recordings rather than offering more staff-led visits.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
